summary: NetClass Technology Inc, a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a registered direct offering priced November 5, 2026, and closed November 6, 2026. The company sold 675,000 Class A ordinary shares at $0.40 per share plus pre-funded warrants for 2,325,000 shares at $0.3875 (strike $0.0125), raising approximately $1.2 million gross, alongside 3,000,000 allocation rights exercisable within 30 days at the same prices. Univest Securities acted as exclusive placement agent for a 7% cash fee plus up to $60,000 expense reimbursement. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes; no board recommendation or special-situation event is present. Watch dilution and the 30-day allotment overhang.
